note: Hermes reads this in the daily sweep. checked_at records a successful source comparison, not necessarily a data change.

sources.policy: Unverified seeds only; never overwrite verified records.
Open an issue when upstream changes; geometry replacement requires human review.

sources.warning: Upstream flags several states as pre-delimitation and some names or alignments as imperfect.
sources.policy: Seek a newer official state/ECI source; open an issue before replacing geometry.
Compare creations, abolitions and renamings with official gazettes; open an issue for geometry changes.
Refresh the oldest as_of first using official law, gazette, tariff, regulator, tender and concession sources.
Verify the responsible body, ownership, regulator and procurement or concession route; never infer auction terms.

After each Union Budget (1 February) and revised estimates, update data/money/flows.json 'union' from Budget at a Glance: receipts, expenditure by major items, expenditure by type, transfers to states. Keep totals balanced; validate_data.py checks this.
When PRS 'State of State Finances' or the RBI 'State Finances: A Study of Budgets' is published, update the 'states' diagram shares and add per-state diagrams as data allows.
